title: Maximum Number of People That Can Be Caught in Tag
goal: Match as many people as possible to distinct taggers within reach.
strategy: List taggers and people in index order. Match the earliest pair when reachable; otherwise discard only the earlier index that is too far away to reach any remaining partner.
